the 52,371-byte difference is explained as memory and settings, but re-reading the two stored bodies shows 34,456 bytes of it (65.8%) is the tools array, because the unfenced arm carries 26 tool definitions the fenced arm does not (20 mcp__imas-dd__ tools, 5 mcp__reckon__ tools, and the MCP resource tools) that the harness home's user-scope config never declares, so the record attributes to memory a saving that is mostly the loss of every MCP tool.
